renfonpaiTitle: Score a double wind pair as 4 fu
renfonpaiDescription:
A pair of a wind that is both the round wind and your seat wind (a double wind)
is scored as 4 fu: 2 fu for the round wind plus 2 fu for the seat wind.
When off, it is 2 fu, the same as any other value tile pair.
kiriageManganDescription:
Wins of 30 fu 4 han and 60 fu 3 han (7,700 points for a non-dealer, 11,600 for the dealer)
are rounded up to mangan (8,000 for a non-dealer, 12,000 for the dealer).
When off, they are scored as they are, without rounding up.
suuankouTankiDoubleTitle: Score suuankou tanki as a double yakuman
suuankouTankiDoubleDescription:
A suuankou won on a single-tile wait (waiting on the pair)
is scored as a double yakuman (64,000 points for a non-dealer, 96,000 for the dealer).
When off, it is a single yakuman.
daisuushiiDoubleTitle: Score daisuushii as a double yakuman
daisuushiiDoubleDescription:
Daisuushii, with triplets of all four winds (East, South, West and North),
is scored as a double yakuman.
When off, it is a single yakuman.
kokushiJuusanmenDoubleTitle: Score a 13-sided kokushi musou as a double yakuman
kokushiJuusanmenDoubleDescription:
A kokushi musou won on the 13-sided wait
is scored as a double yakuman.
When off, it is a single yakuman.
junseiChuurenDoubleTitle: Score junsei chuuren poutou as a double yakuman
junseiChuurenDoubleDescription:
A chuuren poutou won on the 9-sided wait (the pure form)
is scored as a double yakuman.
When off, it is a single yakuman.
fukugouYakumanDescription:
When several yakuman are made at once (such as daisangen plus tsuuiisou),
the score is the sum of them.
When off, it is the score of one yakuman.
autoAdvanceOnCorrectTitle: Go to the next question automatically when correct
autoAdvanceOnCorrectDescription:
In Training and in the scoring drills (Winning Hand and Tenpai Hand Scoring Practice), a correct answer
takes you straight to the next question without the review.
When off, the correct answer stays on screen until you press Next question.
When you are wrong, it always stops, whatever this setting is.
doraDisplayDescription:
Questions show the dora tile itself instead of the dora indicator.
When off, the dora indicator is shown, as in a real game.
termLinksDescription:
Mahjong terms in the lesson text are shown as plain text, not as links.
Use this once you know the terms and the links get in the way of reading.
When off, you can tap a term to check what it means.
fuHanOrderDescription:
Fu and han are shown in the order you look them up in the scoring table, as in "30 fu 4 han", in the scoring table drills and elsewhere.
When off, they are shown as "4 han 30 fu".
scoreInputTitle: Choose the score from a dropdown
scoreInputDescription:
You answer the score from a dropdown that lists every candidate.
When off, you switch between "Below mangan" and "Mangan+" and choose from the score tiles of that side.
You can also switch with the button at the top right of the score field in a practice.
koTsumoInputTitle: Split a non-dealer tsumo into non-dealer and dealer payments
koTsumoInputDescription:
You choose the score of a non-dealer tsumo in two separate fields: from each non-dealer and from the dealer.
When off, you choose a pair such as "300/500" from one field.
This applies when "Choose the score from a dropdown" is on. When you answer with tiles, you always choose a pair.
tileOrientationTitle: Turn tiles upside down at random
tileOrientationDescription:
On the practice board, some tiles in the hand are shown upside down, as on a real table.
The questions and how answers are judged do not change.
The change takes effect when you reopen the practice.
tileOrderDescription:
On the practice board, the hand is shown in random order instead of sorted.
The winning tile is still shown apart on the right.
The questions and how answers are judged do not change.
This also applies to Challenges and promotion exams. Challenge records are kept in the same category as with the normal display.
The change takes effect when you reopen the practice.
leaderboardVisibilityDescription:
When on, your name and results no longer appear on the leaderboard.
Your results are still recorded, so turning it off brings your position back.
leaderboardVisibilityAppDescription:
When on, your username and results no longer appear on the web leaderboard, and the app's "Leaderboard positions" shows no position either.
Your results are still recorded, so turning it off brings your position back.
leaderboardVisibilityFailedToast: We couldn't save the setting. Please try again in a moment.
blockedUsersDescription: People you block do not appear on the leaderboards and public profiles you see.
unblockFailedToast: We couldn't unblock this user. Please try again in a moment.
